spans.s: An epithet of a horse or its driver.
One of the ten horses of the moon.
A nymph. -Comp. -वसुः one of the principal seven rays of the Sun. -वाहः A horseman; आगच्छन् गुरुतरगर्वमर्ववाहैः Śiva.
अर्वश [arvaśa], a. Possessed of coursers, quick. इन्द्रो देवेभि- रर्वशेभिरर्वशः
अर्वाके [arvākē], ind. In the proximity of, near. अर्वाके अस्ति भेषजम्
Turned towards; favouring; turned towards unfavourbly; अर्वाचीनासो वनुषे युयुज्रे
Reverse, contrary; ˚ता state of being posterior or recent; state of being contrary. -नम् ind. (With abl.)
Later than; यदूर्ध्वं पृथिव्या अर्वाचीनमन्तरीक्षात् Śat. Br.
अर्वाच् [arvāc], a. [अवरे काले देशे वा अञ्चति पृषो˚ अर्वादेशः]
Turned towards, coming to meet anyone.
Being on this side (as the bank of a river); (opp. पर).
Being below or behind (in time or place).
Before (in time or place); यत्सृष्टेरर्वाक् सलिलमयं ब्रह्माण्डमभूत्
On the lower side, behind, downwards (opp. ऊर्ध्वम्.

(With loc.) Within, near; एते चार्वागुपवनभुवि छिन्नदर्भाङ्कुरायाम् Ś.1.15.-Comp. -कालः posterior time. -कालिक a. belonging to proximate time, modern; ˚ता modernness, posterity of time; तान्यर्वाक्कालिकतया निष्फलान्यनृतानि च
.-कूलम् the near bank of a river. -तन a. Being on this side of, not reaching up to, posterior; प्रकृतिपुरुषयोरर्वाक्त- नाभिर्नामरूपाकृतिभी रूपनिरूपणम्
. -बिल a. Ved. having the hole or mouth hitherward; अर्वाग्बिलश्चमस ऊध्वर्बुध्नः Bṛi.

a cloud. -सामन् n. Ved. epithet of three days during which the Soma sacrifice is performed. -स्रोतस् m. N. of a creation of beings in which the current of nutriment tends downwards, or where the men are addicted to sensual enjoyments.
अर्वावत् [arvāvat], a. [अवरकालो$स्त्यस्य मतुप् पृषो˚] Later, modern. -f. Proximity.
अर्वावसु [arvāvasu], N. of the Hotṛi of the Gods (देवानां होता).
अर्वुक [arvuka], [अर्व्-हिंसने बाहु˚ उकञ्] N. of a tribe or people in the south mentioned in the Mahābhārata and conquered by Sahadeva; N. of kings living in the southern forest.
